name: @pipeworx/mcp-neiss

tools.name: neiss_injuries
tools.description: National WEIGHTED estimate of consumer-product-related emergency-department injuries from CPSC's NEISS surveillance system — "how many people were injured by X", "ER visits from Y last year". Pass either an exact 4-digit product_code (see neiss_product_codes) or a free-text product name to resolve. Returns the national estimate (NOT a raw case count — NEISS samples ~100 hospitals and CPSC's own estimate is the sum of each sampled case's statistical weight) plus the underlying sample size. Estimates built from fewer than ~20 sampled cases are flagged unstable per CPSC convention and should not be quoted as precise. Optionally narrow by age_range. Covers emergency-department-treated injuries only, not deaths, hospitalizations elsewhere, or injuries that did not reach an ED.

product_code.description: Exact 4-digit CPSC NEISS product code, e.g. "1842". Leading zeros optional.

product.description: Free-text product name instead of a code, e.g. "stairs", "swimming pools". Matched case-insensitively against NEISS product titles; ambiguous matches return candidates instead of a number.

year.description: A single calendar year, e.g. 2024. Default: the most recent year loaded (the response says which).

from_year.description: Start of a year range instead of a single year (inclusive).

to_year.description: End of a year range (inclusive). Requires from_year.

age_range.description: Patient age bucket at time of injury. Default "all" (every age, including unknown).

tools.name: neiss_top_products
tools.description: Rank consumer products by national WEIGHTED emergency-department injury estimate for one year — "what injures people the most", "top products by ER visits", "most dangerous household products". Backed by the same CPSC NEISS national-estimate methodology as neiss_injuries (summed statistical weight, not raw case counts). Optionally narrow by age_range, e.g. age_range="0-4" for products that injure young children most.

year.description: Calendar year. Default: the most recent year loaded (the response says which).

tools.name: neiss_product_codes
tools.description: Look up CPSC NEISS product/activity codes by keyword, e.g. "pool", "ATV", "trampoline" — use this to find the exact product_code to pass to neiss_injuries, or just to see how CPSC categorizes a product. Entirely local (the fixed ~800-code NEISS coding-manual list); no live call.

query.description: Keyword to match against NEISS product titles, case-insensitive substring.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-neiss forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the neiss pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
